Error executing tool query: MeasureNameCollidesWithColumnError: The declared measure name matches a source column on model 'base'.
  at measure 'net_total'
Error executing tool query: stage 'orders': rendered output columns ['customers__regions__name', 'customers__tier', 'nt'] do not match the expected schema ['region', 'tier', 'nt'].

SQL:
WITH _base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    customers.tier AS "orders.customers.tier"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT customers.id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name,
    customers.tier
), _cm_orders__net_sum AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    customers.tier AS "orders.customers.tier",
    CAST(SUM(CAST(orders.amount - customers.discount AS DOUBLE)) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.nt"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    NOT customers.id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name,
    customers.tier
), __slayer_stage_base AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.customers.regions.name" AS "customers__regions__name",
    _stage_inner."orders.customers.tier" AS "customers__tier",
    _stage_inner."orders.nt" AS "nt"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      _base_2."orders.customers.regions.name",
      _base_2."orders.customers.tier",
      _cm_orders__net_sum."orders.nt"
    FROM _base_2
    LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__net_sum
      ON _base_2."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__net_sum."orders.customers.regions.name"
      AND _base_2."orders.customers.tier" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__net_sum."orders.customers.tier"
  ) AS _stage_inner
), _base AS (
  SELECT
    base.customers__regions__name AS "base.customers__regions__name",
    base.customers__tier AS "base.customers__tier",
    CAST(SUM(base.nt) AS DOUBLE) AS "base.net_total"
  FROM __slayer_stage_base AS base
  GROUP BY
    base.customers__regions__name,
    base.customers__tier
), _cm_base__nt_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name AS (
  SELECT
    base.customers__regions__name AS "base.customers__regions__name",
    SUM(base.nt) AS "base.region_net_total"
  FROM __slayer_stage_base AS base
  GROUP BY
    base.customers__regions__name
)
SELECT
  _base."base.customers__regions__name",
  _base."base.customers__tier",
  _base."base.net_total",
  _cm_base__nt_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name."base.region_net_total"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_base__nt_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name
  ON _base."base.customers__regions__name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_base__nt_sum_partition_by_customers__regions__name."base.customers__regions__name"
ORDER BY
  _base."base.customers__regions__name" ASC,
  _base."base.customers__tier" ASC
LIMIT 21

args.message: Net total = sum over orders of (amount − customer discount), treating the discount as a flat amount. Orders with no matching customer are left out. Customers whose region is missing or unknown are grouped under a null region. region_net_total is the total for the whole region, repeated on each tier row.
